compute_smd_hourglass_error.title: compute smd/hourglass/error command

compute_smd_internal_energy.title: compute smd/internal/energy command

compute_smd_plastic_strain.title: compute smd/plastic/strain command
compute_smd_plastic_strain.summary: Define a computation that outputs the equivalent plastic strain per particle.

compute_smd_plastic_strain_rate.title: compute smd/plastic/strain/rate command

compute_smd_rho.title: compute smd/rho command

compute_smd_tlsph_dt.title: compute smd/tlsph/dt command
compute_smd_tlsph_dt.summary: Define a computation that outputs the CFL-stable time increment per particle.

compute_smd_tlsph_strain.title: compute smd/tlsph/strain command
compute_smd_tlsph_strain.summary: Define a computation that calculates the Green-Lagrange strain tensor for particles interacting via the Total-Lagrangian SPH pair style.

compute_smd_tlsph_strain_rate.title: compute smd/tlsph/strain/rate command
compute_smd_tlsph_strain_rate.summary: Define a computation that calculates the rate of the strain tensor for particles interacting via the Total-Lagrangian SPH pair style.

compute_smd_tlsph_stress.title: compute smd/tlsph/stress command
compute_smd_tlsph_stress.summary: Define a computation that outputs the Cauchy stress tensor for particles interacting via the Total-Lagrangian SPH pair style.

compute_smd_triangle_vertices.title: compute smd/triangle/vertices command
compute_smd_triangle_vertices.summary: Define a computation that returns the coordinates of the vertices corresponding to the triangle-elements of a mesh created by the fix smd/wall_surface.

compute_smd_ulsph_effm.title: compute smd/ulsph/effm command
compute_smd_ulsph_effm.summary: Define a computation that outputs the effective shear modulus for particles interacting via the updated Lagrangian SPH pair style.

compute_smd_ulsph_num_neighs.title: compute smd/ulsph/num/neighs command
compute_smd_ulsph_num_neighs.summary: Define a computation that returns the number of neighbor particles inside of the smoothing kernel radius for particles interacting via the updated Lagrangian SPH pair style.

compute_smd_ulsph_strain.title: compute smd/ulsph/strain command
compute_smd_ulsph_strain.summary: Define a computation that outputs the logarithmic strain tensor.

compute_smd_ulsph_strain_rate.title: compute smd/ulsph/strain/rate command
compute_smd_ulsph_strain_rate.summary: Define a computation that outputs the rate of the logarithmic strain tensor for particles interacting via the updated Lagrangian SPH pair style.

compute_smd_ulsph_stress.title: compute smd/ulsph/stress command
compute_smd_ulsph_stress.summary: Define a computation that outputs the Cauchy stress tensor.

compute_smd_vol.title: compute smd/vol command
compute_smd_vol.summary: Define a computation that provides the per-particle volume and the sum of the per-particle volumes of the group for which the compute is defined.

compute_sna_atom.title: compute sna/atom command / compute snad/atom command / compute snav/atom command / compute snap command / compute sna/grid command / compute sna/grid/local command
compute_sna_atom.summary: Define a computation that calculates a set of quantities related to the bispectrum components of the atoms in a group.

compute_sph_e_atom.title: compute sph/e/atom command
compute_sph_e_atom.summary: Define a computation that calculates the per-atom internal energy for each atom in a group.

compute_sph_rho_atom.title: compute sph/rho/atom command

compute_sph_t_atom.title: compute sph/t/atom command
compute_sph_t_atom.summary: Define a computation that calculates the per-atom internal temperature for each atom in a group.

compute_spin.title: compute spin command
compute_spin.summary: Define a computation that calculates magnetic quantities for a system of atoms having spins.

compute_stress_atom.title: compute stress/atom command / compute centroid/stress/atom command
compute_stress_atom.summary: Define a computation that computes per-atom stress tensor for each atom in a group.

compute_stress_cartesian.title: compute stress/cartesian command
compute_stress_cartesian.summary: Compute stress/cartesian defines computations that calculate profiles of the diagonal components of the local stress tensor over one or two Cartesian dimensions, as described in (Ikeshoji).

compute_stress_curvilinear.title: compute stress/cylinder command / compute stress/spherical command
compute_stress_curvilinear.summary: Compute stress/cylinder, and compute stress/spherical define computations that calculate profiles of the diagonal components of the local stress tensor in the specified coordinate system.

compute_stress_mop.title: compute stress/mop command / compute stress/mop/profile command
compute_stress_mop.summary: Compute stress/mop and compute stress/mop/profile calculate components of the local stress tensor using the method of planes (Todd).

compute_tally.title: compute force/tally command / compute heat/flux/tally command / compute heat/flux/virial/tally command / compute pe/tally command / compute pe/mol/tally command / compute stress/tally command
compute_tally.summary: Define a computation that calculates properties between two groups of atoms by accumulating them from pairwise non-bonded computations.

compute_tdpd_cc_atom.title: compute tdpd/cc/atom command
compute_tdpd_cc_atom.summary: Define a computation that calculates the per-atom chemical concentration of a specified species for each tDPD particle in a group.

compute_temp.title: compute temp command
compute_temp.summary: Define a computation that calculates the temperature of a group of atoms.

compute_temp_asphere.title: compute temp/asphere command
compute_temp_asphere.summary: Define a computation that calculates the temperature of a group of aspherical particles, including a contribution from both their translational and rotational kinetic energy.

compute_temp_body.title: compute temp/body command
compute_temp_body.summary: Define a computation that calculates the temperature of a group of body particles, including a contribution from both their translational and rotational kinetic energy.

compute_temp_chunk.title: compute temp/chunk command
compute_temp_chunk.summary: Define a computation that calculates the temperature of a group of atoms that are also in chunks, after optionally subtracting out the center-of-mass velocity of each chunk.

compute_temp_com.title: compute temp/com command
compute_temp_com.summary: Define a computation that calculates the temperature of a group of atoms, after subtracting out the center-of-mass velocity of the group.

compute_temp_cs.title: compute temp/cs command
compute_temp_cs.summary: Define a computation that calculates the temperature of a system based on the center-of-mass velocity of atom pairs that are bonded to each other.

compute_temp_deform.title: compute temp/deform command
compute_temp_deform.summary: Define a computation that calculates the temperature of a group of atoms, after subtracting out a streaming velocity induced by the simulation box changing size and/or shape, for example in a non-equilibrium MD (NEMD) simulation.

compute_temp_deform_eff.title: compute temp/deform/eff command
compute_temp_deform_eff.summary: Define a computation that calculates the temperature of a group of nuclei and electrons in the electron force field model, after subtracting out a streaming velocity induced by the simulation box changing size and/or shape, for example i...

compute_temp_drude.title: compute temp/drude command
compute_temp_drude.summary: Define a computation that calculates the temperatures of core--Drude pairs.

compute_temp_eff.title: compute temp/eff command
compute_temp_eff.summary: Define a computation that calculates the temperature of a group of nuclei and electrons in the electron force field model.

compute_temp_partial.title: compute temp/partial command
compute_temp_partial.summary: Define a computation that calculates the temperature of a group of atoms, after excluding one or more velocity components.

compute_temp_profile.title: compute temp/profile command
compute_temp_profile.summary: Define a computation that calculates the temperature of a group of atoms, after subtracting out a spatially-averaged center-of-mass velocity field, before computing the kinetic energy.

compute_temp_ramp.title: compute temp/ramp command
compute_temp_ramp.summary: Define a computation that calculates the temperature of a group of atoms, after subtracting out an ramped velocity profile before computing the kinetic energy.

compute_temp_region.title: compute temp/region command
compute_temp_region.summary: Define a computation that calculates the temperature of a group of atoms in a geometric region.

compute_temp_region_eff.title: compute temp/region/eff command
compute_temp_region_eff.summary: Define a computation that calculates the temperature of a group of nuclei and electrons in the electron force field model, within a geometric region using the electron force field.

compute_temp_rotate.title: compute temp/rotate command
compute_temp_rotate.summary: Define a computation that calculates the temperature of a group of atoms, after subtracting out the center-of-mass velocity and angular velocity of the group.

compute_temp_sphere.title: compute temp/sphere command
compute_temp_sphere.summary: Define a computation that calculates the temperature of a group of spherical particles, including a contribution from both their translational and rotational kinetic energy.

compute_temp_uef.title: compute temp/uef command
compute_temp_uef.summary: This command is used to compute the kinetic energy tensor in the reference frame of the applied flow field when fix nvt/uef or fix npt/uef is used.

compute_ti.title: compute ti command
compute_ti.summary: Define a computation that calculates the derivative of the interaction potential with respect to lambda, the coupling parameter used in a thermodynamic integration.

compute_torque_chunk.title: compute torque/chunk command
compute_torque_chunk.summary: Define a computation that calculates the torque on multiple chunks of atoms.

compute_vacf.title: compute vacf command
compute_vacf.summary: Define a computation that calculates the velocity auto-correlation function (VACF), averaged over a group of atoms.

compute_vacf_chunk.title: compute vacf/chunk command
compute_vacf_chunk.summary: Define a computation that calculates the velocity auto-correlation function (VACF) for multiple chunks of atoms.

compute_vcm_chunk.title: compute vcm/chunk command
compute_vcm_chunk.summary: Define a computation that calculates the center-of-mass velocity for multiple chunks of atoms.

compute_viscosity_cos.title: compute viscosity/cos command
compute_viscosity_cos.summary: Define a computation that calculates the velocity amplitude of a group of atoms with an cosine-shaped velocity profile and the temperature of them after subtracting out the velocity profile before computing the kinetic energy.

compute_voronoi_atom.title: compute voronoi/atom command
compute_voronoi_atom.summary: Define a computation that calculates the Voronoi tessellation of the atoms in the simulation box.

compute_xrd.title: compute xrd command
compute_xrd.summary: Define a computation that calculates X-ray diffraction intensity as described in (Coleman) on a mesh of reciprocal lattice nodes defined by the entire simulation domain (or manually) using a simulated radiation of wavelength lambda.

create_atoms.title: create_atoms command
create_atoms.summary: This command creates atoms (or molecules) within the simulation box, either on a lattice, or at random points, or on a surface defined by a triangulated mesh.

create_bonds.title: create_bonds command
create_bonds.summary: Create bonds between pairs of atoms that meet a specified distance criteria.

create_box.title: create_box command
create_box.summary: This command creates a simulation box.

delete_bonds.title: delete_bonds command
delete_bonds.summary: Turn off (or on) molecular topology interactions (i.e., bonds, angles, dihedrals, and/or impropers).

dielectric.title: dielectric command
dielectric.summary: Set the dielectric constant for Coulombic interactions (pairwise and long-range) to this value.

dihedral_table.summary: The table and table/cut dihedral styles create interpolation tables of length Ntable from dihedral potential and derivative values listed in a file(s) as a function of the dihedral angle "phi".

dihedral_write.title: dihedral_write command
dihedral_write.summary: Write energy and force values to a file as a function of the dihedral angle for the currently defined dihedral potential.

dihedral_zero.title: dihedral_style zero command
dihedral_zero.summary: Using a dihedral style of zero means dihedral forces and energies are not computed, but the geometry of dihedral quadruplets is still accessible to other commands.

dimension.title: dimension command
dimension.summary: Set the dimensionality of the simulation.

dump.summary: Dump a snapshot of quantities to one or more files once every N timesteps in one of several styles.

dump_adios.title: dump atom/adios command / dump custom/adios command
dump_adios.summary: Dump a snapshot of atom coordinates every N timesteps in the ADIOS-based "BP" file format, or using different I/O solutions in ADIOS, to a stream that can be read on-line by another program.

dump_cfg_uef.title: dump cfg/uef command
dump_cfg_uef.summary: This command is used to dump atomic coordinates in the reference frame of the applied flow field when fix nvt/uef or fix npt/uef is used.

dump_h5md.title: dump h5md command
dump_h5md.summary: Dump a snapshot of atom coordinates every N timesteps in the HDF5 based H5MD file format (de Buyl).

dump_image.title: dump image command / dump movie command
dump_image.summary: Dump a high-quality rendered image of the atom configuration every N timesteps and save the images either as a sequence of JPEG, PNG, TGA, or PPM files, or as a single movie file.

dump_modify.title: dump_modify command / dump_modify command for image/movie options
dump_modify.summary: Modify the parameters of a previously defined dump command.

dump_molfile.title: dump molfile command
dump_molfile.summary: Dump a snapshot of atom coordinates and selected additional quantities to one or more files every N timesteps in one of several formats.

dump_netcdf.title: dump netcdf command / dump netcdf/mpiio command
dump_netcdf.summary: Dump a snapshot of atom coordinates every N timesteps in AMBER-style NetCDF file format.

fitpod_command.title: fitpod command
fitpod_command.summary: Fit a machine-learning interatomic potential (ML-IAP) based on proper orthogonal descriptors (POD); please see (Nguyen and Rohskopf), (Nguyen2023), (Nguyen2024), and (Nguyen and Sema) for details.

fix.title: fix command
fix.summary: Set a fix that will be applied to a group of atoms.

fix_accelerate_cos.title: fix accelerate/cos command
fix_accelerate_cos.summary: Give each atom a acceleration in x-direction based on its z coordinate.

fix_acks2_reaxff.title: fix acks2/reaxff command
fix_acks2_reaxff.summary: Perform the atom-condensed Kohn--Sham DFT to second order (ACKS2) charge equilibration method as described in (Verstraelen).

fix_adapt.title: fix adapt command
fix_adapt.summary: Change or adapt one or more specific simulation attributes or settings over time as a simulation runs.

fix_adapt_fep.title: fix adapt/fep command
fix_adapt_fep.summary: Change or adapt one or more specific simulation attributes or settings over time as a simulation runs.

fix_add_heat.title: fix add/heat command
fix_add_heat.summary: This fix adds heat to particles with the temperature attribute every timestep at a given rate.

fix_addforce.title: fix addforce command
fix_addforce.summary: Add (f_x,f_y,f_z) to the corresponding component of the force for each atom in the group.

fix_addtorque_atom.title: fix addtorque/atom command
fix_addtorque_atom.summary: This fix is intended to add a peratom torque of each individual finite-sized atom in the group to the specified values.

fix_addtorque_group.summary: Add a set of forces to each atom in the group such that:

fix_alchemy.title: fix alchemy command
fix_alchemy.summary: This fix command enables an "alchemical transformation" to be performed between two systems, whereby one system slowly transforms into the other over the course of a molecular dynamics run.

fix_align_self.title: fix align/self command
fix_align_self.summary: Add a torque to each atom in the group which accounts for the reorientation of each particle toward its own velocity, a generic phenomenon called self-alignment (see (Baconnier2025)).

fix_amoeba_bitorsion.title: fix amoeba/bitorsion command
fix_amoeba_bitorsion.summary: This command enables 5-body torsion/torsion interactions to be added to simulations which use the AMOEBA and HIPPO force fields.

fix_amoeba_pitorsion.title: fix amoeba/pitorsion command
fix_amoeba_pitorsion.summary: This command enables 6-body pitorsion interactions to be added to simulations which use the AMOEBA and HIPPO force fields.

fix_append_atoms.title: fix append/atoms command
fix_append_atoms.summary: This fix creates atoms on a lattice, appended on the zhi edge of the system box.

fix_atom_swap.title: fix atom/swap command
fix_atom_swap.summary: This fix performs Monte Carlo swaps of atoms of one given atom type with atoms of the other given atom types.

fix_atom_weight_apip.title: fix atom_weight/apip command
fix_atom_weight_apip.summary: This command approximates the load every atom causes when an adaptive-precision interatomic potential (APIP) according to (Immel) is used.

fix_ave_atom.title: fix ave/atom command
fix_ave_atom.summary: Use one or more per-atom vectors as inputs every few timesteps, and average them atom by atom over longer timescales.

fix_ave_chunk.title: fix ave/chunk command
fix_ave_chunk.summary: Use one or more per-atom vectors as inputs every few timesteps, sum the values over the atoms in each chunk at each timestep, then average the per-chunk values over longer timescales.

fix_ave_correlate.title: fix ave/correlate command
fix_ave_correlate.summary: Use one or more global scalar values as inputs every few timesteps, calculate time correlations between them at varying time intervals, and average the correlation data over longer timescales.

fix_ave_correlate_long.title: fix ave/correlate/long command
fix_ave_correlate_long.summary: This fix is similar in spirit and syntax to the fix ave/correlate.

fix_ave_grid.title: fix ave/grid command
fix_ave_grid.summary: Overlay the 2d or 3d simulation box with a uniformly spaced 2d or 3d grid and use it to either (a) time-average per-atom quantities for the atoms in each grid cell, or to (b) time-average per-grid quantities produced by other computes or...

fix_ave_histo.title: fix ave/histo command / fix ave/histo/weight command
fix_ave_histo.summary: Use one or more values as inputs every few timesteps to create a single histogram.

fix_ave_moments.title: fix ave/moments command
fix_ave_moments.summary: Using one or more values as input, calculate the moments of the underlying (population) distributions based on samples collected every few time steps over a time step window.

fix_ave_time.title: fix ave/time command
fix_ave_time.summary: Use one or more global values as inputs every few time steps, and average them over longer timescales.

fix_aveforce.title: fix aveforce command
fix_aveforce.summary: Apply an additional external force to a group of atoms in such a way that every atom experiences the same force.

fix_balance.title: fix balance command
fix_balance.summary: This command adjusts the size and shape of processor subdomains within the simulation box, to attempt to balance the number of particles and thus the computational cost (load) evenly across processors.

fix_baoab.title: fix baoab command
fix_baoab.summary: Apply the BAOAB Langevin integrator of (Leimkuhler) to the atoms in the fix group.

fix_bocs.title: fix bocs command
fix_bocs.summary: These commands incorporate a pressure correction as described by Dunn and Noid (Dunn1) to the standard MTK barostat by Martyna et al.

fix_bond_break.title: fix bond/break command
fix_bond_break.summary: Break bonds between pairs of atoms as a simulation runs according to specified criteria.

fix_bond_create.title: fix bond/create command / fix bond/create/angle command
fix_bond_create.summary: Create bonds between pairs of atoms as a simulation runs according to specified criteria.

fix_bond_swap.title: fix bond/swap command
fix_bond_swap.summary: In a simulation of polymer chains this command attempts to swap a pair of bonds, as illustrated below.

fix_box_relax.title: fix box/relax command
fix_box_relax.summary: Apply an external pressure or stress tensor to the simulation box during an energy minimization.

fix_brownian.title: fix brownian command / fix brownian/sphere command / fix brownian/asphere command
fix_brownian.summary: Perform Brownian Dynamics time integration to update position, velocity, dipole orientation (for spheres) and quaternion orientation (for ellipsoids, with optional dipole update as well) of all particles in the fix group in each timestep.

fix_charge_regulation.title: fix charge/regulation command
fix_charge_regulation.summary: This fix performs Monte Carlo (MC) sampling of charge regulation and exchange of ions with a reservoir as discussed in (Curk1) and (Curk2).

fix_cmap.title: fix cmap command
fix_cmap.summary: This command enables CMAP 5-body interactions to be added to simulations which use the CHARMM force field.

fix_colvars.title: fix colvars command
fix_colvars.summary: This fix interfaces LAMMPS to the collective variables Colvars library, which allows to accelerate sampling of rare events and the computation of free energy surfaces and potentials of mean force (PMFs) for any set of collective variable...

fix_controller.title: fix controller command
fix_controller.summary: This fix enables control of a LAMMPS simulation using a control loop feedback mechanism known as a proportional-integral-derivative (PID) controller.

fix_damping_cundall.title: fix damping/cundall command
fix_damping_cundall.summary: Add damping force and torque to finite-size spherical particles in the group following the model of Cundall, 1987, as implemented in other granular physics code (e.g., Yade-DEM, PFC).

fix_deform.title: fix deform command
fix_deform.summary: Change the volume and/or shape of the simulation box during a dynamics run.

fix_deform_pressure.title: fix deform/pressure command
fix_deform_pressure.summary: This fix is an extension of the fix deform command, which allows all of its options to be used as well as new pressure-based controls implemented by this command.

fix_deposit.title: fix deposit command
fix_deposit.summary: Insert a single atom or molecule into the simulation domain every M timesteps until N atoms or molecules have been inserted.

fix_dpd_energy.title: fix dpd/energy command
fix_dpd_energy.summary: Perform constant energy dissipative particle dynamics (DPD-E) integration.

fix_dpd_source.title: fix edpd/source command / fix tdpd/source command
fix_dpd_source.summary: Fix edpd/source adds a heat source as an external heat flux to each atom in a spherical or cuboid domain, where the source is in units of energy/time.

fix_drag.title: fix drag command
fix_drag.summary: Apply a force to each atom in a group to drag it towards the point (x,y,z).

fix_drude.title: fix drude command
fix_drude.summary: Assign each atom type in the system to be one of 3 kinds of atoms within the Drude polarization model.

fix_drude_transform.title: fix drude/transform/direct command / fix drude/transform/inverse command
fix_drude_transform.summary: Transform the coordinates of Drude oscillators from real to reduced and back for thermalizing the Drude oscillators as described in (Lamoureux and Roux) using a Nose-Hoover thermostat.

fix_dt_reset.title: fix dt/reset command
fix_dt_reset.summary: Reset the timestep size every N steps during a run, so that no atom moves further than the specified Xmax distance, based on current atom velocities and forces.

fix_efield.title: fix efield command / fix efield/tip4p command
fix_efield.summary: Add a force \vec{F} = q\vec{E} to each charged atom in the group due to an external electric field being applied to the system.

fix_efield_lepton.title: fix efield/lepton command
fix_efield_lepton.summary: Add an electric potential V that applies to a group of charged atoms a force \vec{F} = q \vec{E}, and to dipoles a force \vec{F} = (\vec{p} \cdot \nabla) \vec{E} and torque \vec{T} = \vec{p} \times \vec{E}, where \vec{E} = - \nabla V.

fix_ehex.title: fix ehex command
fix_ehex.summary: This fix implements the asymmetric version of the enhanced heat exchange algorithm (Wirnsberger).

fix_electrode.title: fix electrode/conp command / fix electrode/conq command / fix electrode/thermo command
fix_electrode.summary: The electrode fixes implement the constant potential method (CPM) (Siepmann, Reed), and modern variants, to accurately model electrified, conductive electrodes.

fix_electron_stopping.title: fix electron/stopping command / fix electron/stopping/fit command
fix_electron_stopping.summary: This fix implements inelastic energy loss for fast projectiles in solids.

fix_enforce2d.title: fix enforce2d command
fix_enforce2d.summary: Zero out the z-dimension velocity and force on each atom in the group.

fix_eos_cv.title: fix eos/cv command
fix_eos_cv.summary: Fix eos/cv applies a mesoparticle equation of state to relate the particle internal energy (u_i) to the particle internal temperature (\theta_i).

fix_eos_table.title: fix eos/table command
fix_eos_table.summary: Fix eos/table applies a tabulated mesoparticle equation of state to relate the particle internal energy (u_i) to the particle internal temperature (dpdTheta_i).

fix_eos_table_rx.title: fix eos/table/rx command
fix_eos_table_rx.summary: Fix eos/table/rx applies a tabulated mesoparticle equation of state to relate the concentration-dependent particle internal energy (u_i) to the particle internal temperature (\theta_i).

fix_evaporate.title: fix evaporate command
fix_evaporate.summary: Remove M atoms from the simulation every N steps.

fix_external.title: fix external command
fix_external.summary: This fix allows external programs that are running LAMMPS through its library interface to modify certain LAMMPS properties on specific timesteps, similar to the way other fixes do.

fix_ffl.title: fix ffl command
fix_ffl.summary: Apply a Fast-Forward Langevin Equation (FFL) thermostat as described in (Hijazi).

fix_filter_corotate.title: fix filter/corotate command
fix_filter_corotate.summary: This fix implements a corotational filter for a mollified impulse method.

fix_flow_gauss.title: fix flow/gauss command
fix_flow_gauss.summary: This fix implements the Gaussian dynamics (GD) method to simulate a system at constant mass flux (Strong).

fix_freeze.title: fix freeze command
fix_freeze.summary: Zero out the force and torque on a granular particle.

fix_gcmc.title: fix gcmc command
fix_gcmc.summary: This fix performs grand canonical Monte Carlo (GCMC) exchanges of atoms or molecules with an imaginary ideal gas reservoir at the specified T and chemical potential (\mu) as discussed in (Frenkel).

fix_gemc.title: fix gemc command
fix_gemc.summary: This fix performs Gibbs ensemble Monte Carlo (GEMC) exchanges of atoms and volume between two simulation cells at specified T.

fix_gjf.title: fix gjf command
fix_gjf.summary: Apply a Langevin thermostat as described in (Gronbech-Jensen-2020) to a group of atoms which models an interaction with a background implicit solvent.

fix_gld.title: fix gld command
fix_gld.summary: Applies Generalized Langevin Dynamics to a group of atoms, as described in (Baczewski).

fix_gle.title: fix gle command
fix_gle.summary: Apply a Generalized Langevin Equation (GLE) thermostat as described in (Ceriotti).

fix_graphics_arrows.title: fix graphics/arrows command
fix_graphics_arrows.summary: This fix allows to add arrows to images rendered with dump image using the fix keyword to represent vector properties with arrows for either all atoms in the fix group or for chunks.

fix_graphics_chunk.title: fix graphics/chunk command
fix_graphics_chunk.summary: This fix generates graphics objects from chunks of atoms defined by the compute chunk/atom command.

fix_graphics_isosurface.title: fix graphics/isosurface command
fix_graphics_isosurface.summary: This fix allows to add an isosurface graphics object representing the triangulated isosurface at a given isovalue on a grid to images rendered with dump image using the fix keyword and optionally to output the computed mesh as a series o...

fix_graphics_labels.title: fix graphics/labels command
fix_graphics_labels.summary: This fix allows to add either images or text as "labels" to dump image created images by using the fix keyword.

fix_graphics_lines.title: fix graphics/lines command
fix_graphics_lines.summary: This fix allows to add a trace of averaged atom positions in the fix group to images rendered with dump image using the fix keyword.

fix_graphics_objects.title: fix graphics/objects command
fix_graphics_objects.summary: This fix allows to add arbitrary objects to images rendered with dump image using the fix keyword.

fix_graphics_periodic.title: fix graphics/periodic command
fix_graphics_periodic.summary: This fix allows to add graphics of periodic images of atoms and bonds to dump image images using the fix keyword.

fix_graphics_replica.title: fix graphics/replica command
fix_graphics_replica.summary: This fix allows to add spheres to images rendered with dump image using the fix keyword to represent atoms from all replicas of a multi-replica simulation.

fix_gravity.title: fix gravity command
fix_gravity.summary: Impose an additional acceleration on each particle in the group.

fix_grem.title: fix grem command
fix_grem.summary: This fix implements the molecular dynamics version of the generalized replica exchange method (gREM) originally developed by (Kim), which uses non-Boltzmann ensembles to sample over first order phase transitions.

fix_halt.title: fix halt command
fix_halt.summary: Check a condition every N steps during a simulation run.

fix_heat.title: fix heat command
fix_heat.summary: Add non-translational kinetic energy (heat) to a group of atoms in a manner that conserves their aggregate momentum.

fix_heat_flow.title: fix heat/flow command
fix_heat_flow.summary: Perform plain time integration to update temperature for atoms in the group each timestep.

fix_hmc.title: fix hmc command
fix_hmc.summary: This fix implements the hybrid or Hamiltonian Monte Carlo (HMC) algorithm.

fix_hyper_global.title: fix hyper/global command
fix_hyper_global.summary: This fix is meant to be used with the hyper command to perform a bond-boost global hyperdynamics (GHD) simulation.

fix_hyper_local.title: fix hyper/local command
fix_hyper_local.summary: This fix is meant to be used with the hyper command to perform a bond-boost local hyperdynamics (LHD) simulation.

fix_ilves.title: fix ilves command
fix_ilves.summary: Apply bond-length and angle constraints using the ILVES algorithm of (Lopez-Villellas).

fix_imd.title: fix imd command
fix_imd.summary: This fix implements the "Interactive MD" (IMD) protocol which allows realtime visualization and manipulation of MD simulations through the IMD protocol, as initially implemented in VMD and NAMD.

fix_indent.title: fix indent command
fix_indent.summary: Insert an indenter within a simulation box.

fix_ipi.title: fix ipi command
fix_ipi.summary: This fix enables LAMMPS to be run as a client for the i-PI Python wrapper (IPI).

fix_lambda_la_csp_apip.summary: The potential energy E_i of an atom i according to an adaptive-precision potential is given by (Immel)

fix_lambda_thermostat_apip.title: fix lambda_thermostat/apip command

fix_langevin.title: fix langevin command
fix_langevin.summary: Apply a Langevin thermostat as described in (Bruenger) to a group of atoms which models an interaction with a background implicit solvent.

fix_langevin_drude.title: fix langevin/drude command
fix_langevin_drude.summary: Apply two Langevin thermostats as described in (Jiang1) for thermalizing the reduced degrees of freedom of Drude oscillators.

fix_langevin_eff.title: fix langevin/eff command
fix_langevin_eff.summary: Apply a Langevin thermostat as described in (Schneider) to a group of nuclei and electrons in the electron force field model.

fix_langevin_spin.title: fix langevin/spin command
fix_langevin_spin.summary: Apply a Langevin thermostat as described in (Mayergoyz) to the magnetic spins associated to the atoms.

fix_lb_fluid.title: fix lb/fluid command
fix_lb_fluid.summary: Implement a lattice-Boltzmann fluid on a uniform mesh covering the LAMMPS simulation domain.

fix_lb_momentum.title: fix lb/momentum command
fix_lb_momentum.summary: This fix is based on the fix momentum command, and was created to be used in place of that command, when a lattice-Boltzmann fluid is present.

fix_lb_viscous.title: fix lb/viscous command
fix_lb_viscous.summary: This fix is similar to the fix viscous command, and is to be used in place of that command when a lattice-Boltzmann fluid is present using the fix lb/fluid.

fix_lineforce.title: fix lineforce command
fix_lineforce.summary: Adjust the forces on each atom in the group so that only the component of force along the linear direction specified by the vector (x,y,z) remains.

fix_manifoldforce.title: fix manifoldforce command
fix_manifoldforce.summary: This fix subtracts each time step from the force the component along the normal of the specified manifold.

fix_mdi_qm.title: fix mdi/qm command
fix_mdi_qm.summary: This command enables LAMMPS to act as a client with another server code that will compute the total energy, per-atom forces, and total virial for atom conformations and simulation box size/shapes that LAMMPS sends it.

fix_mdi_qmmm.title: fix mdi/qmmm command
fix_mdi_qmmm.summary: This command enables LAMMPS to act as a client with another server code to perform a coupled QM/MM (quantum-mechanics/molecular-mechanics) simulation.

fix_meso_move.title: fix meso/move command
fix_meso_move.summary: Perform updates of position, velocity, internal energy and local density for mesoscopic particles in the group each timestep using the specified settings or formulas, without regard to forces on the particles.

fix_modify.title: fix_modify command
fix_modify.summary: Modify one or more parameters of a previously defined fix.

fix_mol_swap.title: fix mol/swap command
fix_mol_swap.summary: This fix performs Monte Carlo swaps of two specified atom types within a randomly selected molecule.

fix_momentum.title: fix momentum command / fix momentum/chunk command
fix_momentum.summary: Fix momentum zeroes the linear and/or angular momentum of the group of atoms every N timesteps by adjusting the velocities of the atoms.

fix_move.title: fix move command
fix_move.summary: Perform updates of position and velocity for atoms in the group each timestep using the specified settings or formulas, without regard to forces on the atoms.

fix_msst.title: fix msst command
fix_msst.summary: This command performs the Multi-Scale Shock Technique (MSST) integration to update positions and velocities each timestep to mimic a compressive shock wave passing over the system.

fix_mvv_dpd.title: fix mvv/dpd command / fix mvv/edpd command / fix mvv/tdpd command
fix_mvv_dpd.summary: Perform time integration using the modified velocity-Verlet (MVV) algorithm to update position and velocity (fix mvv/dpd), or position, velocity and temperature (fix mvv/edpd), or position, velocity and concentration (fix mvv/tdpd) for p...

fix_neb.title: fix neb command
fix_neb.summary: Add nudging forces to atoms in the group for a multi-replica simulation run via the neb command to perform a nudged elastic band (NEB) calculation for finding the transition state.

fix_neb_spin.title: fix neb/spin command
fix_neb_spin.summary: Add nudging forces to spins in the group for a multi-replica simulation run via the neb/spin command to perform a geodesic nudged elastic band (GNEB) calculation for finding the transition state.

fix_neighbor_swap.title: fix neighbor/swap command
fix_neighbor_swap.summary: This fix performs Monte-Carlo (MC) evaluations to enable kinetic Monte Carlo (kMC)-type behavior during MD simulation by allowing neighboring atoms to swap their positions.

fix_nh.title: fix nvt command / fix npt command / fix nph command
fix_nh.summary: These commands perform time integration on Nose-Hoover style non-Hamiltonian equations of motion which are designed to generate positions and velocities sampled from the canonical (nvt), isothermal-isobaric (npt), and isenthalpic (nph) e...

fix_nh_eff.title: fix nvt/eff command / fix npt/eff command / fix nph/eff command
fix_nh_eff.summary: These commands perform time integration on Nose-Hoover style non-Hamiltonian equations of motion for nuclei and electrons in the group for the electron force field model.

fix_nh_uef.title: fix nvt/uef command / fix npt/uef command
fix_nh_uef.summary: These fixes can be used to simulate non-equilibrium molecular dynamics (NEMD) under diagonal flow fields, including uniaxial and bi-axial flow.

fix_nonaffine_displacement.title: fix nonaffine/displacement command
fix_nonaffine_displacement.summary: This fix computes different metrics of the nonaffine displacement of particles.

fix_nph_asphere.title: fix nph/asphere command
fix_nph_asphere.summary: Perform constant NPH integration to update position, velocity, orientation, and angular velocity each timestep for aspherical or ellipsoidal particles in the group using a Nose/Hoover pressure barostat.

fix_nph_body.title: fix nph/body command
fix_nph_body.summary: Perform constant NPH integration to update position, velocity, orientation, and angular velocity each timestep for body particles in the group using a Nose/Hoover pressure barostat.

fix_nph_sphere.title: fix nph/sphere command
fix_nph_sphere.summary: Perform constant NPH integration to update position, velocity, and angular velocity each timestep for finite-size spherical particles in the group using a Nose/Hoover pressure barostat.

fix_nphug.title: fix nphug command
fix_nphug.summary: This command is a variant of the Nose-Hoover fix npt fix style.

fix_npt_asphere.title: fix npt/asphere command
fix_npt_asphere.summary: Perform constant NPT integration to update position, velocity, orientation, and angular velocity each timestep for aspherical or ellipsoidal particles in the group using a Nose/Hoover temperature thermostat and Nose/Hoover pressure baros...

fix_npt_body.title: fix npt/body command
fix_npt_body.summary: Perform constant NPT integration to update position, velocity, orientation, and angular velocity each timestep for body particles in the group using a Nose/Hoover temperature thermostat and Nose/Hoover pressure barostat.

fix_npt_cauchy.title: fix npt/cauchy command
fix_npt_cauchy.summary: This command performs time integration on Nose-Hoover style non-Hamiltonian equations of motion which are designed to generate positions and velocities sampled from the isothermal-isobaric (npt) ensembles.

fix_npt_sphere.title: fix npt/sphere command
fix_npt_sphere.summary: Perform constant NPT integration to update position, velocity, and angular velocity each timestep for finite-sizex spherical particles in the group using a Nose/Hoover temperature thermostat and Nose/Hoover pressure barostat.

fix_numdiff.title: fix numdiff command
fix_numdiff.summary: Calculate forces through finite difference calculations of energy versus position.

fix_numdiff_virial.title: fix numdiff/virial command
fix_numdiff_virial.summary: Calculate the virial stress tensor through a finite difference calculation of energy versus strain.

fix_nve.title: fix nve command
fix_nve.summary: Perform plain time integration to update position and velocity for atoms in the group each timestep.

fix_nve_asphere.title: fix nve/asphere command
fix_nve_asphere.summary: Perform constant NVE integration to update position, velocity, orientation, and angular velocity for aspherical particles in the group each timestep.

fix_nve_asphere_noforce.title: fix nve/asphere/noforce command
fix_nve_asphere_noforce.summary: Perform updates of position and orientation, but not velocity or angular momentum for atoms in the group each timestep.

fix_nve_body.title: fix nve/body command
fix_nve_body.summary: Perform constant NVE integration to update position, velocity, orientation, and angular velocity for body particles in the group each timestep.

fix_nve_bpm_sphere.title: fix nve/bpm/sphere command
fix_nve_bpm_sphere.summary: Perform constant NVE integration to update position, velocity, angular velocity, and quaternion orientation for finite-size spherical particles in the group each timestep.

fix_nve_dot.title: fix nve/dot command
fix_nve_dot.summary: Apply a rigid-body integrator as described in (Davidchack) to a group of atoms, but without Langevin dynamics.

fix_nve_dotc_langevin.title: fix nve/dotc/langevin command
fix_nve_dotc_langevin.summary: Apply a rigid-body Langevin-type integrator of the kind "Langevin C" as described in (Davidchack) to a group of atoms, which models an interaction with an implicit background solvent.

fix_nve_eff.title: fix nve/eff command
fix_nve_eff.summary: Perform constant NVE integration to update position and velocity for nuclei and electrons in the group for the electron force field model.

fix_nve_limit.title: fix nve/limit command
fix_nve_limit.summary: Perform constant NVE updates of position and velocity for atoms in the group each timestep.

fix_nve_line.title: fix nve/line command
fix_nve_line.summary: Perform constant NVE integration to update position, velocity, orientation, and angular velocity for line segment particles in the group each timestep.

fix_nve_manifold_rattle.title: fix nve/manifold/rattle command
fix_nve_manifold_rattle.summary: Perform constant NVE integration to update position and velocity for atoms constrained to a curved surface (manifold) in the group each timestep.

fix_nve_noforce.title: fix nve/noforce command
fix_nve_noforce.summary: Perform updates of position, but not velocity for atoms in the group each timestep.

fix_nve_sphere.title: fix nve/sphere command
fix_nve_sphere.summary: Perform constant NVE integration to update position, velocity, and angular velocity for finite-size spherical particles in the group each timestep.

fix_nve_spin.title: fix nve/spin command
fix_nve_spin.summary: Perform a symplectic integration for the spin or spin-lattice system.

fix_nve_tri.title: fix nve/tri command
fix_nve_tri.summary: Perform constant NVE integration to update position, velocity, orientation, and angular momentum for triangular particles in the group each timestep.

fix_nvk.title: fix nvk command
fix_nvk.summary: Perform constant kinetic energy integration using the Gaussian thermostat to update position and velocity for atoms in the group each timestep.

fix_nvt_asphere.title: fix nvt/asphere command
fix_nvt_asphere.summary: Perform constant NVT integration to update position, velocity, orientation, and angular velocity each timestep for aspherical or ellipsoidal particles in the group using a Nose/Hoover temperature thermostat.

fix_nvt_body.title: fix nvt/body command
fix_nvt_body.summary: Perform constant NVT integration to update position, velocity, orientation, and angular velocity each timestep for body particles in the group using a Nose/Hoover temperature thermostat.

fix_nvt_manifold_rattle.title: fix nvt/manifold/rattle command
fix_nvt_manifold_rattle.summary: This fix combines the RATTLE-based (Andersen) time integrator of fix nve/manifold/rattle (Paquay) with a Nose-Hoover-chain thermostat to sample the canonical ensemble of particles constrained to a curved surface (manifold).

fix_nvt_sllod.title: fix nvt/sllod command
fix_nvt_sllod.summary: Perform constant NVT integration to update positions and velocities each timestep for atoms in the group using a Nose/Hoover temperature thermostat.

fix_nvt_sllod_eff.title: fix nvt/sllod/eff command
fix_nvt_sllod_eff.summary: Perform constant NVT integration to update positions and velocities each timestep for nuclei and electrons in the group for the electron force field model, using a Nose/Hoover temperature thermostat.

fix_nvt_sphere.title: fix nvt/sphere command
fix_nvt_sphere.summary: Perform constant NVT integration to update position, velocity, and angular velocity each timestep for finite-size spherical particles in the group using a Nose/Hoover temperature thermostat.

fix_oneway.title: fix oneway command
fix_oneway.summary: Enforce that particles in the group and in a given region can only move in one direction.

fix_orient.title: fix orient/fcc command / fix orient/bcc command
fix_orient.summary: The fix applies an orientation-dependent force to atoms near a planar grain boundary which can be used to induce grain boundary migration (in the direction perpendicular to the grain boundary plane).

fix_orient_eco.title: fix orient/eco command
fix_orient_eco.summary: The fix applies a synthetic driving force to a grain boundary which can be used for the investigation of grain boundary motion.

fix_pafi.title: fix pafi command
fix_pafi.summary: Perform Brownian or Langevin integration whilst constraining the system to lie in some hyperplane, which is expected to be the tangent plane to some reference pathway in a solid state system.

fix_pair.title: fix pair command

fix_phonon.title: fix phonon command
fix_phonon.summary: Calculate the dynamical matrix from molecular dynamics simulations based on fluctuation-dissipation theory for a group of atoms.

fix_pimd.title: fix pimd/langevin command / fix pimd/nvt command / fix pimd/langevin/bosonic command / fix pimd/nvt/bosonic command
fix_pimd.summary: Fix pimd was renamed to fix pimd/nvt and fix pimd/langevin was added.

fix_planeforce.title: fix planeforce command
fix_planeforce.summary: Adjust the forces on each atom in the group so that only the components of force in the plane specified by the normal vector (x,y,z) remain.

fix_plumed.title: fix plumed command
fix_plumed.summary: This fix instructs LAMMPS to call the PLUMED library, which allows one to perform various forms of trajectory analysis on the fly and to also use methods such as umbrella sampling and metadynamics to enhance the sampling of phase space.

fix_polarize.title: fix polarize/bem/gmres command / fix polarize/bem/icc command / fix polarize/functional command
fix_polarize.summary: These fixes compute induced charges at the interface between two impermeable media with different dielectric constants.

fix_pour.title: fix pour command
fix_pour.summary: Insert finite-size particles or molecules into the simulation box every few timesteps within a specified region until N particles or molecules have been inserted.

fix_precession_spin.title: fix precession/spin command
fix_precession_spin.summary: This fix applies a precession torque to each magnetic spin in the group.

fix_press_berendsen.title: fix press/berendsen command
fix_press_berendsen.summary: Reset the pressure of the system by using a Berendsen barostat (Berendsen), which rescales the system volume and (optionally) the atoms coordinates within the simulation box every timestep.

fix_press_langevin.title: fix press/langevin command
fix_press_langevin.summary: Adjust the pressure of the system by using a Langevin stochastic barostat (Gronbech), which rescales the system volume and (optionally) the atoms coordinates within the simulation box every timestep.

fix_print.title: fix print command
fix_print.summary: Print a text string every N steps during a simulation run.

fix_propel_self.title: fix propel/self command
fix_propel_self.summary: Add a force to each atom in the group due to a self-propulsion force.

fix_property_atom.title: fix property/atom command
fix_property_atom.summary: Create one or more additional per-atom vectors or arrays to store information about atoms and to use during a simulation.

fix_python_invoke.title: fix python/invoke command
fix_python_invoke.summary: This fix allows you to call a Python function during a simulation run.

fix_python_move.title: fix python/move command
fix_python_move.summary: The python/move fix style provides a way to define ways how particles are moved during an MD run from python script code, that is loaded from a file into LAMMPS and executed at the various steps where other fixes can be executed.

fix_qbmsst.title: fix qbmsst command
fix_qbmsst.summary: This command performs the Quantum-Bath coupled Multi-Scale Shock Technique (QBMSST) integration.

fix_qeq.title: fix qeq/point command / fix qeq/shielded command / fix qeq/slater command / fix qeq/ctip command / fix qeq/dynamic command / fix qeq/fire command
fix_qeq.summary: Perform the charge equilibration (QEq) method as described in (Rappe) and formulated in (Nakano) (also known as the matrix inversion method) and in (Rick) (also known as the extended Lagrangian method) based on the electronegativity equi...

fix_qeq_comb.title: fix qeq/comb command
fix_qeq_comb.summary: Perform charge equilibration (QeQ) in conjunction with the COMB (Charge-Optimized Many-Body) potential as described in (COMB_1) and (COMB).

fix_qeq_reaxff.title: fix qeq/reaxff command
fix_qeq_reaxff.summary: Perform the charge equilibration (QEq) method as described in (Rappe and Goddard) and formulated in (Nakano).

fix_qeq_rel_reaxff.title: fix qeq/rel/reaxff command
fix_qeq_rel_reaxff.summary: This fix implements the QEqR method (Lalli) for charge equilibration, which differs from the QEq charge equilibration method (Rappe and Goddard) only in how external electric fields are accounted for.

fix_qmmm.title: fix qmmm command
fix_qmmm.summary: This fix provides functionality to enable a quantum mechanics/molecular mechanics (QM/MM) coupling of LAMMPS to a quantum mechanical code.

fix_qmmm_xtb.title: fix qmmm/xtb command
fix_qmmm_xtb.summary: This fix performs a non-covalent, electrostatically embedded GFN1-xTB or GFN2-xTB QM/MM calculation in a three-dimensional periodic cell.

fix_qtb.title: fix qtb command
fix_qtb.summary: This command performs the quantum thermal bath scheme proposed by (Dammak) to include self-consistent quantum nuclear effects, when used in conjunction with the fix nve or fix nph commands.

fix_qtpie_reaxff.title: fix qtpie/reaxff command
fix_qtpie_reaxff.summary: The QTPIE charge equilibration method is an extension of the QEq charge equilibration method.

fix_reaxff_bonds.title: fix reaxff/bonds command
fix_reaxff_bonds.summary: Write out the bond information computed by the ReaxFF potential specified by pair_style reaxff in the exact same format as the original stand-alone ReaxFF code of Adri van Duin.

fix_reaxff_species.title: fix reaxff/species command
fix_reaxff_species.summary: Write out the chemical species information computed by the ReaxFF potential specified by pair_style reaxff.

fix_recenter.title: fix recenter command
fix_recenter.summary: Constrain the center-of-mass position of a group of atoms by adjusting the coordinates of the atoms every timestep.

fix_restrain.title: fix restrain command
fix_restrain.summary: Restrain the motion of the specified sets of atoms by making them part of a bond or angle or dihedral interaction whose strength can vary over time during a simulation.

fix_rheo.title: fix rheo command
fix_rheo.summary: Perform time integration for RHEO particles, updating positions, velocities, and densities.

fix_rheo_oxidation.title: fix rheo/oxidation command
fix_rheo_oxidation.summary: This fix dynamically creates bonds on the surface of fluids to represent physical processes such as oxidation.

fix_rheo_pressure.title: fix rheo/pressure command
fix_rheo_pressure.summary: This fix defines a pressure equation of state for RHEO particles.

fix_rheo_thermal.title: fix rheo/thermal command
fix_rheo_thermal.summary: This fix performs time integration of temperature for atom style rheo/thermal.

fix_rheo_viscosity.title: fix rheo/viscosity command
fix_rheo_viscosity.summary: This fix defines a viscosity for RHEO particles.

fix_rhok.title: fix rhok command
fix_rhok.summary: The fix applies a force to atoms given by the potential

fix_rigid.title: fix rigid command / fix rigid/nve command / fix rigid/nvt command / fix rigid/npt command / fix rigid/nph command / fix rigid/small command / fix rigid/nve/small command / fix rigid/nvt/small command / fix rigid/npt/small command / fix rigid/nph/small command
fix_rigid.summary: Treat one or more sets of atoms as independent rigid bodies.

fix_rigid_meso.title: fix rigid/meso command
fix_rigid_meso.summary: Treat one or more sets of mesoscopic SPH/SDPD particles as independent rigid bodies.

fix_rx.title: fix rx command
fix_rx.summary: Fix rx solves the reaction kinetic ODEs for a given reaction set that is defined within the file associated with this command.

fix_saed_vtk.title: fix saed/vtk command
fix_saed_vtk.summary: Time average computed intensities from compute saed and write output to a file in the third generation vtk image data format for visualization directly in parallelized visualization software packages like ParaView and VisIt.

fix_set.title: fix set command
fix_set.summary: Reset one or more properties of one or more atoms once every Nfreq steps during a simulation.

fix_setforce.title: fix setforce command / fix setforce/spin command
fix_setforce.summary: Set each component of force on each atom in the group to the specified values fx,fy,fz.

fix_settorque_atom.title: fix settorque/atom command
fix_settorque_atom.summary: This fix is intended to set the peratom torque of individual finite-size atoms in the fix group to the specified values.

fix_sgcmc.title: fix sgcmc command
fix_sgcmc.summary: This command allows to carry out parallel hybrid molecular dynamics/Monte Carlo (MD/MC) simulations using the algorithms described in (Sadigh).

fix_shake.title: fix shake command / fix rattle command
fix_shake.summary: Apply bond and angle constraints to specified bonds and angles in the simulation by either the SHAKE or RATTLE algorithms.

fix_shardlow.title: fix shardlow command
